meta.name: site-audit
meta.description: Crawl any website and produce a technical SEO health audit — health score, broken links, duplicate content, missing meta tags. Works like Ahrefs Site Audit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取网站并生成技术SEO健康评分与问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果运营网站且关心搜索排名,想快速找出影响SEO的技术问题。
copy.tagline_en: Crawl any website and get a technical SEO health score with an issue list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to identify technical SEO issues quickly.

howto.what: 它通过网站的sitemap爬取页面，生成技术SEO健康报告：给出健康评分，并列出死链、重复标题、缺失meta等16类问题。
howto.when: 当用户提到“site audit”“health check”等，或要求查找死链、重复标题、缺失meta描述等时触发；也适合网站改版后或月度检查。

say.text: 帮我审计 https://example.com 的SEO健康状态
say.note: 会爬取站点并给出健康评分和问题列表。

say.text: 检查我网站上有哪些404死链
say.note: 会列出内部指向404页面的链接。

say.text: 对比上个月的SEO审计报告
say.note: 能指出改进点和回退项。

howto.what_en: Crawls any website via its sitemap and produces a technical SEO health report: gives an Ahrefs-style health score, and flags issues like broken links, duplicate titles/descriptions, missing meta tags (16 categories).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a 'site audit', 'health check', or 'technical SEO audit', or want to find broken links, duplicate titles, missing meta descriptions. Also suits post-redesign/migration or monthly audits.

say_en.text: Audit the SEO health of https://example.com
say_en.note: Crawls the site and returns a health score with issues.

say_en.text: Check my website for 404 broken links
Compare this report with last month's audit
